profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.summary: I am a software developer with a diverse career background in music industry and construction. I love to build new things and fix broken things. I thrive in an environment where the details matter and problem-solving may be coupled with creativity. Throughout my experiences, I've grown in my ability to communicate with a broad range of people. I have learned that quality communication is often a big driver of success when working with a team or client, and I carry this approach into all of my work.

positions.title: Full-stack Software Developer
positions.description:
• Engineering core components of a patient self-care reporting application, working
collaboratively with a small team to deliver intuitive healthcare monitoring solutions
• Developing a robust and secure backend using NestJS, Prisma, and SQL, integrated with
a Remix-based frontend to support separate dashboards for Patients and Healthcare
Providers
• Utilizing TypeScript as the primary programming language for both front-end and back-
end development
• Leveraging GitHub for efficient project management, version control, and team
collaboration
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · Remix · NestJS · Prisma ORM · SQL

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
NSS is a six-month intensive full-time software development bootcamp focusing on HTML, CSS, Javascript, React and server-side fundamentals with Python and Django.

• Single-page application development with React and with a focus on modern ES6+ Javascript features    and modular code
• Project management with issue tickets and GitHub Projects
• Database planning by building entity relationship diagrams (ERD) to define relationships with an    emphasis on maintaining a flat data structure 
• Utilized vanilla JavaScript (ES6), and React.js to create single page dynamic web applications using full    CRUD functionality
• Styled applications using CSS, Bootstrap, reactstrap, and Material UI
• Completed group project sprints while fully remote, comfortable with Slack, Zoom, GitHub Projects, and    wireframes for group communications and collaboration

Projects:

BaseCamp-Planner  |  Front-end Capstone 

An intuitive and engaging app that allows travelers to explore hiking areas with an interactive USA map, and then create an efficient  trip plan/hiking itineraries around BaseCamp locations. Map functionality was designed with HTML image mapping to create unique UX/UI, and Google maps API was embedded as an extra aid for the user. 
•  React | JSX | JavaScript 
•  JSON server as a local database
•  Full CRUD functionality
•  Styled with MUI and CSS
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · JavaScript · Communication · Next.js · React

positions.title: Custom Cabinet/Furniture Maker
positions.description:
• Provide estimate for scope of work/timeline of completion

• Adhere precisely to design specifications and measurements to ensure proper installation and customer    satisfaction
• Solve design problems and other issues as they arise

• Track expenses and profits for bookkeeping

projects.title: Pan-Am Airlines Booking Application | Full-stack Capstone
projects.description:
Now called Fan-Am, this is a mock flight booking and management application for the deceased Pan-Am airlines. Users may choose one-way/round-trip parameters and search available nonstop and multi-leg flight options. Bookings are stored in the user’s account and can be changed/canceled.  The app has full CRUD functionality and uses a server built with Django and a SQLite database.
 • Front end:  Next.js  |  JavaScript  |  MUI  |  CSS Modules     
 • Back end:   Django  |  Python  |  SQLite  |  Poetry

Github links:
https://github.com/ericsteedly/pan-am
https://github.com/ericsteedly/pan-am-api

projects.description:

Map functionality was designed with HTML image mapping to create unique UX/UI, and Google maps API was embedded as an extra aid for the user. 
• React | React Router | JavaScript 
• JSON server as a local database
• Full CRUD functionality
• Styled with MUI and CSS

Github links:
